description: Validates a rule in Dolphin's rule language and returns it cleaned, in plain words, with any warnings (e.g. leverage) - or exactly what is wrong. Use before backtest_rule, or to help someone write a rule for their Dolphin agent. A rule can also ask Jev (TypeSafe's decision model) to approve each buy - confirm: { brain: "jev", minPct: 60 } - which runs on Dolphin with the person's own Jev key.

rule.description: A trading rule in Dolphin's rule language - the same one the build chat writes and the live engine runs.

action.description: How it enters. It sells through its exits.

confirm.description: Optional. Ask Jev (TypeSafe's decision model) to approve each buy on Dolphin, with the runner's own Jev key. Backtests skip it.

minPct.description: How sure Jev must be, 50-95. Default 60.

cooldownMinutes.description: Wait after any trade before the next entry. Default 0.

leverage.description: Futures only, 1-5. Above 3x comes with a liquidation warning.

stopLossPct.description: Exit at this % price move against the position.

takeProfitPct.description: Exit at this % price move in favour.

until.description: Exit when ALL hold. May be empty if a stop-loss or take-profit is set.

items.description: One condition, judged on the last CLOSED candle. Kinds: rsi {op: above|below, value 1-99, period?=14}; price {op, value}; price_vs_ma {op, ma: sma|ema, length}; ma_cross {direction: up|down, fast, slow, ma?: sma|ema}; macd_cross {direction: up|down} (12/26/9); trend {direction: up|down, candles 1-20} (that many closes in a row each higher/lower); change_pct {op, value (% , negative for drops), candles}.

venue.description: Where it trades. Shorts and leverage need binance-futures.

items.description: One condition, judged on the last CLOSED candle. Kinds: rsi {op: above|below, value 1-99, period?=14}; price {op, value}; price_vs_ma {op, ma: sma|ema, length}; ma_cross {direction: up|down, fast, slow, ma?: sma|ema}; macd_cross {direction: up|down} (12/26/9); trend {direction: up|down, candles 1-20} (that many closes in a row each higher/lower); change_pct {op, value (% , negative for drops), candles}.

name: check_rule
title: Check a trading rule
